subject.title: [Bug]: z.ai endpoint auto-detection probe sends no User-Agent → z.ai 429s it, detectZaiEndpoint returns null, Coding Plan onboarding fails

question: Should maintainers require redacted live Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection proof before merging the linked User-Agent fix, or accept the credential gap for this narrow source/test-backed repair?
rationale: The source-level fix is narrow and well-scoped, but the external z.ai edge behavior cannot be re-proven here without credentials.

options.title: Provide or require live proof
options.body: Wait for a maintainer or contributor with a redacted Coding Plan key to show endpoint detection selecting the coding endpoint after the header fix.

options.title: Accept the credential gap
options.body: Merge a focused PR based on the reporter's live before-fix evidence plus regression coverage, explicitly accepting that live after-fix proof was not available.

recommendation.title: Provide or require live proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a maintainer or contributor with a redacted Coding Plan key to show endpoint detection selecting the coding endpoint after the header fix.

likelyOwner.reason: He is both the current issue assignee and the feature-history owner for the Z.AI Coding Plan detection path.
